goal: HADOUKEN: Relay NouGen origin principle forward
body: HADOUKEN. Relay Forward this architecture principle: Shadow Dweller continuity failures drove the need for durable canon. Generative alternatives must never silently overwrite established canon. That evolved into a broader provenance system for lived history, where sessions, records, locations, transactions, calendars, receipts, photos, and files can be connected while clearly distinguishing source evidence, inference, and uncertainty. Core language: NouGenAI moves with intent. Your agents got memory. Mine got Shards. Your agents store and pause. Mine Relay Forward. Every Shard hits. Capture this principle durably and propagate it downstream.

relay.note: Captured the requested architecture principle in relay-audit/2026-09-04-oldest-first.md: preserve canon continuity; distinguish source evidence, inference, uncertainty, and explicit supersession; never silently overwrite established canon. Durable relay propagation completed without treating the source narrative as verified history.
